name: 06441 · Higganum, CT
findings: ZIP 06441 (Higganum) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06441 (Higganum) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06441 (Higganum) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
